# API contract changelog

<!-- Generated by `make sdk-gen-cpp` from sdk/changelog. DO NOT EDIT. -->

This is the shared API contract history for the C++ signing core and reference examples, not the package release history. Package versions are independent of the contract versions below. Unreleased changes describe the current contract, not a published C++ artifact. C++ supplies signing functions for signed requests and tested reference examples, not an RPC or stream runtime.

Contract versions follow semver. Before 1.0.0 the minor digit is the breaking one: a breaking change goes from 0.3.x to 0.4.0, anything else (new calls, fields, enum values, deprecations, wording) to the next patch. From 1.0.0 on: breaking → major, additions → minor, wording → patch.

A method keeps its meaning once released. When the server adds a new version of a call, the SDKs get a new method with the version in its name (`create_order_v2`); the existing method keeps calling the version it was released with.
